_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Scanning Electron Microscope Analysis Report
summary: The Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM) Analysis Report documents the quality and acceptability of metallization on semiconductor dice, addressing batch-process-oriented metallization defects.
description_purpose: The purpose of the Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM) Analysis Report is to document the quality and acceptability of metallization on semiconductor dice. It addresses the specific metallization defects that are batch process orientated and that can best be identified utilizing this method.
application_interrelationship: This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product resulting from the work task described in MIL-STD-883, Method 2018.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report may be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: Refer to MIL-STD-883, Method 2018, for additional content clarification. The report shall include the following:

children.title: Names of individuals who prepared the report
Photographs.
children.content: There shall be a minimum of three photographs per lot. Two photographs shall show the worst case oxide steps and one photograph shall the worst case general metallization. If any photograph shows another apparent defect within the field of view, another photograph shall be included to certify the extent of the apparent defect.
